text: Config pasifizasyonu TAMAM: 6 eksik config canli Sub-1'den kopyalandi (ChangeClass.xml, CustomBuyVip.txt, CustomJewel.txt, ZenDrop.xml guncel, EventTime.xml, ThuMuaDoExc.txt). 2 format duzeltmesi: CustomJewel LoadXML(.xml)->Load(.txt), ThuMuaDoExc .xml->.txt (canli exe kanitiyla).
